description: Capabilities for the embedded console window: remote-access settings only. The console is navigated to a loopback HTTP origin (WebviewUrl::External), so Tauri treats its IPC requests as remote and only grants them via the `remote` allowlist below, scoped to loopback. Grants the four remote-access app commands by their autogenerated allow-$command permission (see build.rs AppManifest) -- core:default does not grant app commands, since app commands only bypass ACL on a local origin with no app manifest declared, which no longer holds once build.rs declares one.
